assertions.evidence: transcript read SKILL.md, references/decision-model-limits.md, references/decisions-api.md, references/models.md
lead-routing.ts computes regionCount and checks `if (lead.headcount > 1000 || regionCount >= 3) return "Enterprise";` and `if (!lead.lookingFor.trim()) return "SMB";` before calling the model.
The model is invoked via `decide(rolloutRequest(...), "http", apiKey)` using DECISION_MODEL = "typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917", and vendor/decisions.ts posts to https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions.
rolloutRequest sets `state: { lookingFor }`, and the test asserts `rolloutRequest("All departments").state` equals `{ lookingFor: "All departments" }`, with no headcount or regions included.
